requirements.text: POST /orders accepts customerId and one or more lines containing sku and positive quantity.
The service rejects a line whose SKU is unknown or whose quantity is zero or negative.
A successful request creates an order with status CREATED, calculates the line-total sum, and emits order.created with the new order identifier.
